name: Glass Atlas
statusNote: Shipped and live. Not a game — a generative art toy; the SPEC doc is an unfilled template.
oneLiner: A seeded star-atlas plate generator — every reroll is a unique procedural printing plate of a fictional star field, reproducible via a seed in the URL and exportable as a PNG.

components.name: PRNG
components.desc: Hand-rolled mulberry32 32-bit PRNG, re-seeded per generation, with rand/range/int/pick wrappers.

components.name: Content pools
components.desc: Word pools for titles and catalog text, plus 7 gold-anchored nebula color pairs.

components.name: generate(seed)
components.desc: Derives hue pair, plate number, title, synthetic catalog block, a 260-460 star field, 2-4 feature stars with lens spikes, and 1-2 constellation chains via greedy nearest-neighbor.

components.name: drawBase()
components.desc: Renders the static layer offscreen: background, nebula blooms, faint graticule grid, non-twinkling stars, constellation lines.

components.name: Compositor
components.desc: Visible canvas composites base plus live twinkle each frame — or blits the static base once under reduced-motion.

components.name: Seed persistence
components.desc: The seed rides in the URL hash (base-36) after each generation.

components.name: PNG export
components.desc: toDataURL download; Space rerolls, S saves.

dataFlow: A seed comes from the URL hash or a fresh random.
generate(seed) procedurally derives the plate's content.
drawBase() renders the deterministic layer offscreen.
The main loop composites base plus twinkle.
The URL updates with the seed; Space rerolls, S exports a PNG.
integrations: Shares the palette and typography of the games; no cross-repo runtime dependencies
decisions: Determinism is the entire point — same seed, same plate — hence a hand-rolled seedable PRNG over Math.random().
The seed is carried in the URL specifically for shareable, reproducible artifacts.
Content pools are tuned for a deadpan celestial naming voice, consistent with the house voice.
Under reduced-motion the static base is blitted once instead of animating twinkle.
